slides.title: Ropedia raises $22M to scale human-centric data collection for embodied AI
slides.tldr: FUNDING FOR EMBODIED AI DATA COLLECTION
slides.highlight: Ropedia is scaling human-centric data collection for embodied AI, which is relevant to RwB's focus on embodied social robots and human-robot interaction.

slides.title: CoRenew: A large language model agent-based policy simulation platform for multifamily residential redevelopment
slides.tldr: LLM-BASED POLICY SIMULATION FOR RESIDENTIAL REDEVELOPMENT
slides.highlight: CoRenew uses LLM-based agents to simulate stakeholder negotiations and evaluate policy effects, aligning with MIMIC's focus on societal-scale simulation and LLM-based agent models.

card.one_liner: CoRenew is an LLM-agent platform for simulating multi-round stakeholder negotiations in multifamily residential redevelopment policy evaluation.
card.key_idea: It uses LLM-based resident agents structured by the Theory of Planned Behavior, synthetic population generation, and weighted representative selection to simulate adaptive responses to policy interventions.
card.evaluation: Validated against 324 resident surveys (100% directional agreement on 19 paths) and a real-world nine-month negotiation case study.

slides.title: Do Visual Features Improve Other-Initiated Repair Detection? A Dyadic Multimodal Approach
slides.highlight: This research demonstrates that incorporating visual features like gaze and gestures improves the detection of other-initiated repairs, supporting HyECHO's goals in multimodal social perception and listener modeling.

card.one_liner: Visual features improve the detection and classification of other-initiated repairs in multimodal conversational dialogue.
card.key_idea: A hierarchical multimodal model integrating text, audio, and CA-grounded visual features (gaze, facial expressions, posture, gestures) extracted via OpenFace and MediaPipe Holistic.
card.evaluation: Evaluated on NOXI (French) and CABB-S (Dutch) corpora using macro-F1; TriModal outperformed text-audio baselines and zero-shot Qwen2.5-Omni-7B.
card.limitation: High variance in NOXI results due to severe class imbalance and small sample sizes for specific repair types.

slides.title: Belief-Aware Influence and Trust (BAIT): Shaping Human Belief During Repeated Human-Robot Interaction
slides.tldr: OPTIMIZING HUMAN TRUST AND INFLUENCE IN REPEATED HRI
slides.highlight: The BAIT controller manages the trade-off between long-term influence and human trust in repeated interactions, supporting RwB's focus on human-robot interaction.

card.one_liner: BAIT balances long-term influence and human trust to maintain task performance during repeated human-robot interactions.
card.key_idea: A hierarchical particle filter infers short-term strategies and long-term beliefs, which a belief-aware MPPI planner uses to optimize the trade-off between unpredictability and transparency.
card.evaluation: Evaluated via simulations, a human-subject study, and real-world GEM vehicle lane-merging; BAIT matched influence-only baselines' performance while significantly increasing user trust.
card.limitation: The approach relies on a structured human model and specific latent state assumptions to maintain computational tractability.

slides.title: Not Forgotten: Implementation and Evaluation of a Personalized Episodic Memory for the Humanoid Robot Head Kim
slides.tldr: EPISODIC MEMORY ENHANCES SOCIAL ROBOT RELATIONS
slides.highlight: This work demonstrates that a personalized episodic memory module for a humanoid robot head increases perceived sociability, trustworthiness, and warmth. It is relevant to RwB's focus on embodied social robots and human-robot interaction.

card.one_liner: Episodic memory in a humanoid robot head increases perceived sociability without increasing user disturbance.
card.key_idea: A lightweight module using vector-based semantic retrieval and a hybrid scoring function (combining cosine similarity, recency, access frequency, and emotional intensity) to inject past interactions into LLM prompts.
card.evaluation: Within-subjects video-based study (N=43) using the HRIES scale. Results showed significant increases in trustworthiness (d=0.62) and warmth (d=0.56), with no change in disturbance (d=0.00).
card.limitation: Video-based format lacked real-time interaction; the sample was limited to university students; the specific retrieval architecture's superiority over simpler methods was not tested.

slides.title: Teachy Mini: Development and Preliminary Evaluation of a Knowledge-Based Generative Social Robot for Higher Education
slides.tldr: KNOWLEDGE-BASED GENERATIVE SOCIAL ROBOT FOR TUTORING
slides.highlight: This work introduces Teachy Mini, a generative social robot using knowledge-based design to provide responsible tutoring behavior, aligning with RwB's focus on embodied social robots and AI-mediated learning.

card.one_liner: Teachy Mini is a knowledge-based generative social robot designed for responsible, personalized tutoring in higher education.
card.key_idea: Operationalizes Knowledge-Based Design (KBD) using system prompting, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and stateful prompt orchestration to integrate self-, user-, and context-knowledge into an LLM-driven robot.
card.evaluation: Between-subjects study (N=24) comparing KBD vs. control. Measured via knowledge tests and scales; Teachy Mini showed significantly higher perceived responsible behavior.
card.limitation: Preliminary evaluation with a small sample size (N=24) and a single-session interaction context.

slides.title: StARS: Socially Appropriate Robot Actions via a Recommender System-Driven Approach
slides.highlight: StARS uses a recommender system framework to generate user-specific appropriateness scores for robot actions, supporting the RwB goal of personalized human-robot interaction.

card.one_liner: StARS personalizes robot action selection by treating social appropriateness as a recommender system preference problem.
card.key_idea: A model-agnostic framework using multi-task matrix factorization and residual fusion to combine collaborative filtering with learnable scene representations for user-specific appropriateness scores.
card.evaluation: Evaluated on MannersDB+ and SocNav1 using various backbones (MLPs, GNNs). Metrics include RMSE, MSE, Pearson r, and CCC; results show statistically significant improvements.

slides.title: Italian Startup Debuts Gene.01 Humanoid With Skin That Senses Humans Before Contact
slides.highlight: The Gene.01 humanoid features skin capable of sensing humans before contact, which is relevant to RwB's focus on human-robot interaction.

slides.title: Extended Reality as a Mediation Layer for Situated Human Control in Human-Robot Teaming
slides.highlight: This research proposes using Extended Reality as a mediation layer to enhance human ability to shape and interrupt robot actions in dynamic environments, supporting RwB's focus on human-robot interaction.

card.one_liner: XR should act as a bidirectional mediation layer for situated human control in human-robot teaming.
card.key_idea: Proposes four mediation functions and six design dimensions to make robot autonomy inspectable, adjustable, and accountable via spatial grounding and multimodal interaction in dynamic environments.
card.evaluation: Not clearly stated; the paper outlines a research agenda and suggests operational tests rather than reporting experimental results.
card.limitation: The paper is a position piece providing a conceptual framework and research agenda rather than a validated system.
